secrets.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional. Telegram bot token from @BotFather, needed only to enable server-verified Telegram Stars purchases (payments are disabled by default; the game runs fully without it).

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional. Secret of at least 32 characters set when registering the Telegram webhook (Telegram login?setWebhook). Required only when Telegram Stars purchases are enabled.

secrets.name: SURGE_SUPPORT_CONTACT
secrets.description: Optional. Support handle shown in payment help messages, e.g. @your_support. Required only when Telegram Stars purchases are enabled.
